verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing says it 'automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team' and offers 'customizable automation' for onboarding and ongoing monitoring. Docs also show some background behaviors, such as pending reviews that reopen automatically after about 90 days. However, workflow configuration is described as something Hummingbird staff set up for you, not something users build themselves. Missing for 10: user-facing docs on creating and configuring automations, detail on triggers and scheduling for background runs, evidence of autonomous agent execution beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
